name: New Machine Account Assigned
description: Sent to notify a user that they have been assigned as the owner of a machine account.
subject: You are now the owner of machine account $data.accountName
body:
New Machine Account Assigned

Hello $data.ownerName,

You have been assigned as the owner of a machine account. You are responsible for managing this account and keeping it up to date.

Machine account: $data.accountName

Source: $data.sourceName

If you have questions, contact your administrator.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
